```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r, message = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# Reading data
background <- read_csv("../data/background-clean.csv")

# Preprocessing data
background_cleaned <- background %>% 
  mutate(courses = str_split(courses, ",\\s*")) %>%
  mutate(num_courses = lengths(courses))
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = background_cleaned, mapping = aes(x = as.factor(num_courses), y = stat.comf)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Courses",
    y = "Comfort Level with Statistics",
    title = "Distribution of Comfort Level by Number of Courses"
  )
```


```{r}
# Linear Regression
lm_model <- lm(stat.comf ~ num_courses, data = background_cleaned)
summary(lm_model)
```


```{r}
# Boxplots with fitted linear regression line
ggplot(data = background_cleaned, mapping = aes(x = num_courses, y = stat.comf)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = factor(num_courses))) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  labs(
    x = "Number of Courses",
    y = "Comfort Level with Statistics",
    title = "Distribution of Comfort Level by Number of Courses"
  )
```
